licensor.entityDescription: Wyoming limited liability company registered to do business in Pennsylvania

legalConfiguration.venue: State or federal courts of competent jurisdiction in Wyoming, subject to mandatory applicable law
legalConfiguration.operatingRegistration: Pennsylvania foreign registration / authority to do business (user-confirmed)
activationBlockers: Complete and retain a beat-specific sample/source provenance attestation; obtain any necessary third-party clearances before final license execution.
Complete and sign the beat-specific Producer Rights / Sample Declaration for each beat before paid licensing.
Resolve any beat-specific provenance hold, including remix/derivative-work questions and prior-client/exclusive commitments.
For the four MP3-origin sources, supply a genuine lossless source master before any tier promises a true lossless master.
Supply original DAW stems/trackouts before Trackout Pro is marketed as original trackouts. Derived stereo-separation packs are not original multitracks.
Have final contract language reviewed by a qualified attorney before enabling paid checkout.

publishing.note: Default split applies to the new composition unless a signed split sheet or third-party rights schedule states otherwise.

masterRoyalty.note: No separate producer master royalty is charged under these standard templates unless a beat-specific schedule states otherwise.

commonBusinessTerms.thirdPartySync: Film, television, advertising, games, branded campaigns, and other third-party synchronization require separate written approval unless expressly added to the executed agreement.
commonBusinessTerms.contentIdNonExclusive: Prohibited without prior written consent because multiple valid non-exclusive users may exist.
commonBusinessTerms.contentIdExclusive: Permitted only after written confirmation from Licensor addressing prior surviving leases and any required whitelisting.
prohibitedUses: Reselling, sublicensing, or distributing the Beat by itself or substantially by itself.
Uploading the Beat or stems to sample libraries, stock-music libraries, beat packs, or competing marketplaces.
Claiming authorship of the Beat itself.
Training or fine-tuning a generative AI model on the Beat or stems without separate written permission.
Using the Beat in unlawful, defamatory, or rights-infringing material.
commonBusinessTerms.priorLeaseRule: A later exclusive license does not terminate valid non-exclusive licenses granted before the exclusive effective date.

rightsActivation.note: Technical audio analysis alone does not establish sample clearance or chain of title.

royaltyAdministration.note: The beat license allocates composition ownership but does not waive separately administered songwriter/publisher royalties. Parties may register and collect their respective shares through applicable PROs, The MLC, publishers, administrators, distributors, or other lawful systems.
royaltyAdministration.metadataRequirement: Licensee must preserve accurate songwriter, publisher, producer and ownership metadata reasonably supplied by Licensor.

derivedStems.disclosure: Drums/percussion, bass and harmonic/music components are algorithmically derived from the stereo master. They are not original DAW multitracks and do not satisfy the default Trackout Pro promise unless the executed Schedule A expressly substitutes derived stems.

commonBusinessTerms.wavDerivativeDisclosure: For four legacy MP3-origin beats, a WAV delivery derivative is available, but the agreement and Schedule A must disclose that converting/decoding MP3 to WAV does not restore lost source information.

tiers.label: Basic MP3 Lease
files: Tagged or untagged high-quality MP3 as specified at delivery
tiers.contentId: Not permitted without prior written consent

tiers.label: Premium WAV Lease
files: Genuine lossless WAV only when a genuine lossless source exists
tiers.contentId: Not permitted without prior written consent

tiers.label: Trackout Pro — Derived 3-Stem
files: 3 derived separation stems: drums/percussion, bass, music/harmonic
tiers.contentId: Not permitted without prior written consent
tiers.availabilityRule: Available for all 22 current catalogue beats as an algorithmically derived 3-stem separation pack after QC. These are not original DAW multitracks and may contain separation bleed/artifacts.

tiers.label: Unlimited Non-Exclusive Lease
files: Genuine lossless WAV only when a genuine lossless source exists
Original DAW trackouts/stems only if specifically listed in Schedule A
tiers.contentId: Not permitted without prior written consent

tiers.label: Exclusive Beat License
files: Genuine lossless WAV only when a genuine lossless source exists
Original DAW stems/trackouts if they actually exist and are listed in Schedule A
tiers.publishingSplit: 50% Bundles / 50% Licensee-side writers by default unless signed split sheet changes it
tiers.copyrightStructure: Exclusive license for use of the Beat in one New Song; not an automatic assignment of the underlying Beat composition or source-recording copyright.
tiers.futureLicenses: Licensor stops granting new beat licenses after the exclusive effective date.
tiers.contentId: May be permitted after written clearance/whitelisting confirmation

sampleProvenance.rule: Final license execution requires a completed beat-specific source-provenance attestation and any necessary third-party clearances.
